title: Cyrene Package Runtime and Binding Admission Protocols v1
description: Production Unix-socket JSONL contracts for the Platform package runtime control surface and its runtime-maintenance binding-operation admission. The stdio development control stream is outside this authenticated UDS contract.
$comment: 未知字段、旧版本和混合方法变体必须拒绝；目录锁仅在 broker Health 精确报告协议及 capability 后才允许绑定变更。

environment.description: Environment forwarding is limited by the daemon to 256 entries and 256 KiB total encoded values.

controlAuth.description: Empty auth is accepted only for a real SO_PEERCRED UID 0 peer. Product callers supply both source_id and source_token.

bindingOperationRequest.description: Both methods require the exact advertised binding-operations protocol_version. No legacy or mixed method variant is accepted.

brokerRequest.description: This lock scopes Health and binding-operation calls; unrelated maintenance methods use their own contracts.

already_in_flight.description: If true, do not execute the mutation again.

already_completed.description: If true, do not execute the mutation again.

const: BeginMaintenance an active CORE_RUNTIME hold with restart confirmation
stop Package Runtime mutation daemon, Products, Workspace updater/timers, and other control clients; drain requests
stop cyrene-kernel.service and confirm process exit
ensure cyrene-runtime-maintenance init-catalog and all other direct state writers are not running
stop cyrene-runtime-maintenance.service and verify MainPID=0 and no live UDS

const.ordinaryGateOpenWhilePresent: allow only a structurally valid COMPLETE marker; strictly load schema2 live snapshot and replay the full journal; do not compare live file hashes with frozen target or backup hashes

rootOnlyArtifactFiles.schema1SourceBackups: exact original v1 source bytes; match source hashes
rootOnlyArtifactFiles.schema2TargetBackups: exact v2 migration target bytes; match target hashes
rootOnlyArtifactFiles.rollbackTargetFiles: exact generated compatible v1 rollback pair; match rollback target hashes

maintenanceTokenBinding.comparedWith: sha256 of CLI proof maintenance_token and the active persisted maintenance hold token

const.phaseHashScope: phaseFileHashCombinations are checked only while completing or recovering the offline migration before ordinary schema2 writes begin

completePhaseSemantics.phaseFileHashCombination: target_state_sha256+target_journal_sha256 marks the migration completion image
completePhaseSemantics.migrationCommandResume: treat as completed; do not rewrite live state or require current live hashes to equal the frozen migration image
completePhaseSemantics.rollbackBaseline: target hashes bind immutable schema2 target backup files and migration baseline, not live files after normal writes

offlineStopOrder: stop Package Runtime mutation daemon, Products, Workspace updater/timers, and other control clients; drain requests
stop candidate cyrene-kernel.service and confirm process exit
stop candidate cyrene-runtime-maintenance.service and verify no live UDS
run rollback-state with the same proof while all state writers remain stopped
start old Broker then old Kernel; verify old Health and exact active hold
EndMaintenance as RolledBack, then resume mutation clients
const.preservesBindingAndCompletedAdmissionMap: exactly according to schema1_profile rules; released profile requires empty maps and omits them, experimental profile preserves exact migration baseline

const.knownPhaseRecovery: resume only with exact proof, marker identity, backup identities, and the phase-specific source/target hashes
const.unknownPhaseOrHashOrMalformedArtifact: fail-closed; do not rewrite or clear; explicit repair required

const.withAnyNonCompleteMarker: fail-closed; no ordinary Gate open or service readiness

completeTargetHashes.meaning: frozen migration completion image and rollback baseline
completeTargetHashes.checkedFor: migration completion/recovery phase and immutable backup verification
completeTargetHashes.notUsedAs: post-migration live state or journal integrity hashes

authorityAdvertisesOnlyAfter.const: SERVING+exact broker protocol_version+both required state and binding capabilities present+same catalog_generation; unrelated capabilities allowed

legacyBrokerBehavior.const: missing exact Health capability means no daemon capability and no mutation; no fallback

requestIdCorrelation.const: same control request_id, admission request_id, receipt request_id, completion request_id

failureReceiptRule.const: post-admission runtime error may carry binding_operation receipt; it is not success and Product SDK must not Complete without durable successful owner-state commit

inFlightReplayBehavior.const: BINDING_OPERATION_PENDING error with typed receipt; no rerun

completedReplayBehavior.const: read-only RuntimeStatus success with typed receipt; no rerun

postAdmissionMutationErrorBehavior.const: error may carry typed receipt; Product SDK does not auto-complete

capabilities.description: Empty unless the broker Health result has the exact supported broker protocol, both required persistence and binding capabilities, and the same catalog generation; only this exact Package Runtime capability is advertised.

operation_token.description: Secret completion capability; do not log.

already_in_flight.description: If true, the mutation was not executed again.

already_completed.description: If true, the completed mutation was not executed again.

maintenance_token.description: Secret hold capability; do not log or include in the marker.
